item.title: Interesting Things from Webpack Sources
item.description: A lot of frontend projects use webpack as a bundler tool. It allows to transform, bundle, or package different resources like JavaScript, styles, images, or fonts. Recently I’d been exploring webpack sources and I found several interesting solutions to different programming problems that can be used in JavaScript projects.
